mapper.select: SELECT day.*, com.name AS companyName, pro.name AS productName,dsp.name AS dspName FROM data_dsp_slot_day AS day LEFT JOIN dsp_slot_info AS dsp ON dsp.id = day.dsp_slot_id LEFT JOIN dsp_company AS com ON dsp.company_id = com.id LEFT JOIN dsp_product AS pro ON dsp.product_id = pro.id WHERE day.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND day.date = #{date} ORDER BY day.id DESC
